name: Techopolis
description: Docker Container for Techopolis Minecraft Modpack The docker on first run will download the same version as tagged of Techopolis and install it. This can take a while as the Forge installer can take a bit to complete. You can watch the logs and it will eventually finish. After the first run it will simply start the server.

paths.name: Installed Location
paths.description: Path to store the installed server files.

variables.name: EULA
variables.description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting. Set to 'true' to accept.

variables.name: OPS
variables.description: Comma separated list of players to have op capability

variables.name: LEVELTYPE
variables.description: Select a level type level-type=skyblockbuilder\:custom_skyblock (Skyblock mode, enable skyblock recipes in game) level-type=hexlands:hexlands (Hexlands) level-type=hexlands:hexlands_overworld_only (Hexlands, overworld only) level-type=default (Default Minecraft World Gen) level-type=terraforged (Terraforged World Gen)
